cohort: The study included 576 women who intended a hospital-based waterbirth and entered the waterbirth tub across 8 hospitals in 2 health systems.
finding: Of the women who entered the waterbirth tub, 48% exited prior to birth, primarily due to maternal choice (50%), medical indication (32%), or provider decision (13%); completion of waterbirth was associated with parity and intrapartum care provider experience.
mod_finding: Giving birth in the tub was associated with parity and intrapartum care provider experience, and nearly half of women intending waterbirth exited the tub prior to delivery.
